title: Match SAR detections to AIS using probability rasters + length/recall adjustments and score threshold
description: Match SAR detections to AIS tracks by computing a probability distribution of vessel location at acquisition time from AIS positions before/after the image, using precomputed probability rasters by vessel class, speed, and time interval. Evaluate probability at each detection and adjust using (1) detection likelihood term based on recall as a function of vessel length and spacing, and (2) length-consistency term comparing AIS known length and SAR estimated length. Compute a score matrix for candidate matches and assign matches iteratively (select best available match and remove) to outperform simple interpolation methods. Select a match acceptance threshold calibrated to global expected matches; paper uses 7.4×10^-6.

inputs.length_lookup: AIS vs SAR length difference table

outputs.matched_vessels: Detections labeled as AIS-matched (bright) vs not matched (dark) with match metadata
